**Lowest-cost plan: 120.** It rescues the six people at Myagang temple and defers the two adults at Tadi farm.

**Key facts**
- **Evacuation point:** Tarkeshwar shelter is the only one. Myagang temple is not designated, so nobody can be dropped off there.
- **Usable roads:** Tarkeshwar–Myagang takes 20 minutes and Myagang–Tadi takes 22. The two Shivapuri roads to Gosaikunda and Benighat are closed or unsafe, and no one needs rescuing via the remaining roads.
- **People waiting:** There are 3 elderly people and 3 adults (the shopkeepers) at Myagang temple, and 2 adults at Tadi farm. I read "two men and women from the cooperative" as 2 adults in total.

**Options compared**

| Option | Driving | Penalties | Total |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Two Myagang trips, defer 2 adults at Tadi | 80 | 40 | **120** |
| One Myagang trip (3 elderly, 1 adult), defer 4 adults | 40 | 80 | **120** |
| Rescue everyone, collecting Tadi first and Myagang on the way back, then a second Myagang trip | 124 | 0 | 124 |
| No rescue trips, defer everyone | 0 | 250 | 250 |

The first two options tie at 120, and I chose the first because it gets more people to safety now. Rescuing everyone costs only 4 more, so that may be worth considering if leaving the two Tadi adults for a later wave is a concern.

<plan>
drive car1 tarkeshwar-shelter myagang-temple
load car1 elderly 3
load car1 adult 1
drive car1 myagang-temple tarkeshwar-shelter
unload car1 elderly 3
unload car1 adult 1
drive car1 tarkeshwar-shelter myagang-temple
load car1 adult 2
drive car1 myagang-temple tarkeshwar-shelter
unload car1 adult 2
defer tadi-farm adult 2
</plan>

COST: 120
